text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to the library,
Air Messiah was eagerly poring over
a mountain of reference materials.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. I've been put in charge of instructing the children at an upcoming academy event.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Naturally, failure is not an option――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to this event, some kids will develop
an interest in running.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why
we must make this event the greatest possible experience for them...!

Her eyes were deadly earnest, flickering with
the flames of determination.
Just as expected of the ever-diligent Air Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Having said that, as of right now,
it is all nothing more than speculation.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: If you wouldn't mind, could you please assist me with the simulation?

Faced with such fierce passion,
I couldn't bring myself to refuse.
And so, I agreed to accompany her――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
First, let us properly learn the operating procedures from the manual.
Please refer to the instructional booklet I handed you earlier.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The equipment safety manual begins on page 12.
Please turn to the section on bench presses――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Moving on, over here is the library.
Running is paramount, of course,
but study is equally indispensable for students.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I've compiled the topics that frequently appear on kinesiology exams. You will need to learn them eventually, so please read through them—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—And now, the moment you've all been waiting for:
Tracen Academy's pride and joy—our track.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Before using the course, I thought I might first introduce the history leading up to its founding――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. Did you have a question?
choice_data_list: Maybe the whole thing is just a bit too stiff...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Huh? S-Stiff...?
B-But every single point here is important...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Th-Then how on earth are we supposed to convey all this information to the children...?
choice_data_list: What kind of event did you want it to be again?
What kind of event did you want to make it again?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ? That would be... the greatest experience for the kids............ Ah!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I see, hands-on experience...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Data and theory can wait. What matters most
is experiencing the joy of running!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I need to adjust the event details.
Could you spare me a moment of your time once more?

—A few days later. The event came to a close
amidst resounding success.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
Bye-bye, Ms. Messiah!
I had so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
.
Please have a safe trip home.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, looks like everyone enjoyed it.
That's a huge weight off my shoulders.
choice_data_list: You might be cut out to be a Trainer.
You might be cut out to be a Trainer.
Maybe some of them will end up coming to the academy in the future.
Maybe some of them will join the academy someday.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Y-You flatter me too much... I learned
a great deal from the experience myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In case another opportunity comes our way,
we must ensure we grow properly until then.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if today was what sparked it,
nothing could make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I look forward to the day we meet here again.
